svg.title: For a diagonal original label stock with probabilities wi > 0, survival is S(t) = P i wie−γit, not generally an exponential. Its no-transition posterior is wi(t) = wie−γit/S(t). Therefore a reset wave or a reset binary flag does not reset the actual label stock. An arbitrarily prescribed time-dependent hazard −S′(t)/S(t) can imitate the survival of this one specified mixture; it does not establish preparation- independent microscopic closure, restore the retained label correlations, or license independent successive samples.
